title: Fukanzazengi Part 6
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk emphasizes the importance of being present and aware in meditation practice, suggesting that simply showing up with an open mind is enough, rather than trying to achieve a specific state or skill. This approach is rooted in Dogen's text Phukan Zazengi, which challenges traditional notions of meditation as a skill to be learned and mastered. By embracing this mindset, individuals can cultivate a deeper understanding of their own nature and the true value of Zen practice lies not in its historical accuracy, but in its ability to convey a wordless, transcendent reality.
